title: Cristian Mungiu Is Glad You’re Arguing About ‘Fjord.’ Just Don’t Assume His Politics
summary: The Romanian auteur is on the cusp of his Oscars breakthrough for his Cannes-winning social drama, which has already been hotly debated on social media for months: "People...assume that what the film says is the opinion of the filmmaker, and what the characters say is the truth. Come on."
